# toPdfAConformance

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`PdfAConformanceInput`](pdf-a-conformance-input.md) to the [`PdfAConformance`](pdf-a-conformance.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toPdfAConformance(input: PdfAConformanceToken | PdfAConformance): PdfAConformance
```
